== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34565) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Law LS No Idea.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 29 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>3e47e060e4bd8d7ecb3c3b8ca476cf7cd036226dbdeaf6be1a43024b67b0420d</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.
